contract: Validated committed pending offers, right-parsed derived idempotency keys and nonce-bound acknowledgement CAS through the Store; no effect dispatch.
limits: Pending may be offered repeatedly until acked; no exactly-once effects or guaranteed delivery.
Consumer dispatch/failure policy is separate from durable state; persistence depends on the selected Store.
No scheduler, retry loop, dispatcher or external-effect confirmation is supplied.

grounding.claim: Finite pending/ack, repeated-offer, key parsing, malformed input, nonce confirmation, retention and reader-write audit scenarios against Memory.
Elixir validation, exceptions and BEAM execution are upstream contracts, not proved here.
OTP 29.1.2 GenServer, process lifecycle and crypto APIs are upstream contracts; no disk durability or exactly-once guarantee.
Consumers use the derived idempotency key with an appropriate destination policy and acknowledge only their documented effect commit point; external effects are not proved.

telemetry.contract: Callable offers/ack boundary with no emitted telemetry.

config.contract: Per-call pending limit; declared destination and payload limits come from the Store configuration.

control.contract: No dispatcher process or lifecycle is supplied.
